templates_dir.description: Directory to search for Jinja templates (corresponds to ionit --templates)

config_dir.description: Configuration directory containing context for rendering (corresponds to ionit --config)

template_extension.description: Extension to look for in template directory (corresponds to ionit --template-extension)

context.description: Flat list of key-value pairs to inject into the rendering context. Used to simulate the JSON/YAML context files ionit reads.

services.description: List of service objects that ionit might generate configurations for. Each object contains service metadata.
